onboarding.welcomeBody: No account, no email, no password. Your money stays on this device unless you decide otherwise.
onboarding.currencyWhy: We picked this from your device. Change it now if it's wrong. Later you can only change it while a Space is still empty.
onboarding.profileWhy: You can change any of this later in Settings.

incomeDriven.name: Regular income
incomeDriven.body: For a household or personal budget with regular income. Periods run automatically from one payday to the next, and one-off receipts add to your free money.

budget.name: Budget
budget.body: For a goal or an event with a limit on money, a date, or both. Set the budget, record what you spend, and see if you stay within it.
budget.examples: A trip, a renovation, an office purchase.

flow.name: Flow
flow.body: For irregular income, or when you simply want to see spending ahead. Starts from the money you have now and shows how far it goes.
flow.examples: Freelance, living on savings, open-ended planning.

local.name: Local
local.body: Stored on this device only. Fast, fully private, works without a network. It will not appear on another device and cannot be shared.

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.notYet: Not available in this version yet.

space.firstBody: A Space is one budget. Keep separate things separate: home, a trip, freelance work.
space.modeIsPermanent: You choose this once. Each type works out money its own way, so a Space keeps the type it started with.
space.currencyFreezes: You can change it until the first entry is added.
space.currencyFrozen: This Space already has entries, so its currency stays. A new Space can use another one.
space.deleteConfirm: This erases everything in "{title}" from this device, for good. Type its name to confirm.
space.archiveConfirm: "{title}" moves out of sight. Nothing is deleted, and you can bring it back any time.
space.archiveBody: Archiving hides the Space without deleting anything. It can be brought back from the Spaces switcher, under Archived.

income.amountRequired: An amount is needed to mark this received.

income.roleAdditionalHint: Adds to the money available without moving period boundaries.
income.noRegular: No regular income yet. Add your salary to start planning periods.

income.deleteRuleBody: The upcoming dates of "{title}" go. Money you've already received stays.
income.ruleAmountHint: Changes every date still to come. Dates you've marked received keep their own amount.
income.ruleScheduleHint: A new schedule moves the dates still to come. Ones marked received stay put.
income.regenerateBody: We'll set out the upcoming dates for "{title}" from its schedule again. Dates you deleted come back, and changed amounts or names go back to the usual ones. Anything already received or in a closed period stays as it is.
income.anchorHelpBody:
Your money is planned in periods, usually from one payday to the next. The income that starts a period is the anchor, most often your salary.

A period starts with the anchor's amount. Everything due before the next anchor comes out of it, and the Dashboard shows what's left.

Other regular incomes are additional: they add to the period they land in, but don't start a new one.

To change which income is the anchor, use the pin on the Incomes screen. At least one regular income always stays the anchor.

category.titleTaken: A category with this name already exists.

decryption.title: We can't open your data right now
decryption.body: Your data is still here, but the key that opens it is missing. It usually happens after clearing app data or moving to a new phone.
decryption.confirmBody: The database stays unreadable without the key. Starting over deletes it and opens onboarding. This cannot be undone.

schedule.uncertaintyNote: If the date falls on a weekend or a holiday, the anchor moves to the nearest working day — forward, unless that would leave the month.

holidays.title: Weekends and holidays

recovery.title: Recovery Key
recovery.why: A password only you know. It protects your backups and gets you back in if this device loses its encryption key. Keep it somewhere safe, like a password manager or on paper. Without it, nobody can recover your data, not even us.
recovery.wrongKey: This is not the Recovery Key
recovery.oldBackups: Backups made before today open only with the old key.
recovery.plate: Your data isn't backed up yet. Set it up in a minute.
recovery.notSetWarning: Without a Recovery Key there are no backups, and a lost key on this device means lost data.

security.title: Security
security.appLockHint: Asks for the PIN on start and after 45 seconds in the background
security.blockScreenshotsHint: Also hides the app in the recent apps list
security.noScreenshotBlockOnDesktop: Not available on this platform: Windows and Linux have no way for an app to block screenshots
security.protectWhy: Optional. A PIN keeps curious eyes out; your data is encrypted either way. Fingerprint unlock is added if your device has it.
security.passwordAtStart: Protected by the password asked at every start

passphrase.setTitle: Set a password to protect your data
passphrase.why: This computer has no place to store keys safely, so we'll ask for this password each time you start. If you forget it, your Recovery Key gets you back in.
passphrase.noRecovery: No Recovery Key was set on this device, so the data cannot be opened without the password.
